Senses.Explanation: Literally "single, sole" (單) and "transmit" (傳): "transmit singly," attested 692 times in 211 allowlisted texts. Zhongfeng says Bodhidharma's coming west is "called single transmission and direct pointing" and "at first had no twists and turns" (謂之單傳直指，初無委曲). In another address he gives a direct local definition: "the four holy and six ordinary [classes] are each originally complete; this is called single transmission," then asks, "what is transmitted?" (各各本來具足謂單傳，傳箇甚麼). Frequent compounds are "single transmission and direct pointing" (單傳直指), "single transmission of the mind-seal" (單傳心印), and "single transmission outside the teachings" (教外單傳).
Senses.Note: The records place the term in lineage slogans, questions, and verse. One lamp record pairs, "Bodhidharma came from the west, singly transmitting the mind-seal; the Sixth Patriarch of Caoxi did not know one written character" (達磨西來，單傳心印，曹溪六祖，不識一字). A later lineage statement says the flower-holding smile was entrusted as "single transmission outside the teachings" (教外單傳). The four direct-question occurrences and twelve "termed single transmission" formulas belong to this shared lineage wording, not master-specific senses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所以達磨西來謂之單傳直指。初無委曲。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Extensive Record of Tianmu Zhongfeng (天目中峰廣錄), in Zhongfeng Mingben's own address to the assembly at Huanzhu Chan Cloister. Zhongfeng Mingben is the exact speaker saying that Bodhidharma's coming west is called single transmission and direct pointing, without circumlocution. Bodhidharma is the person discussed, not the speaker of this sentence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四聖六凡各各本來具足謂單傳。傳箇甚麼。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 天目中峰廣錄. Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Zhongfeng Mingben as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 達磨西來，單傳心印。曹溪六祖，不識一字。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), Baizhang Weigu section. Baizhang Weigu is the exact speaker who pairs Bodhidharma's single transmission of the mind-seal with the Sixth Patriarch Huineng's not knowing one written character.
